description: This PHP source file defines the class 'LibraryDiscoveryParser' which parses and manages library files (YAML format) for Drupal extensions, handling library definitions, overrides, and dependencies.

classes.name: LibraryDiscoveryParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing library YAML files, handling overrides, dependencies, and providing library data for Drupal extensions.

methods.name: buildByExtension
methods.description: Builds library definitions for a given extension, handling core, modules, and themes, including validation and override application.

methods.name: parseLibraryInfo
methods.description: Parses the YAML library file for an extension, merges with component libraries, and allows module and theme alterations.

methods.name: applyLibrariesMovedOverrides
methods.description: Applies overrides for moved or renamed library files, with deprecation warnings.

methods.name: librariesForComponents
methods.description: Generates library definitions for single-directory components.

methods.name: applyLibrariesOverride
methods.description: Applies theme-specific overrides to library definitions.

methods.name: isValidUri
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid URI.

methods.name: setOverrideValue
methods.description: Overrides specific assets within a library based on theme overrides.

methods.name: resolveThemeAssetPath
methods.description: Resolves relative paths for theme assets to full paths.

methods.name: validateCssLibrary
methods.description: Validates the structure of CSS library definitions.
